image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a dark, textured surface. The salamander has a glossy black body with vivid yellow spots and stripes. Its head is broad with visible parotoid glands, and its skin appears moist and reflective. The limbs are short and stout. There is faint, illegible text in the bottom left corner.
